class.name: GameplayTagCountContainer
class.brief_description: Reference-counted set of tags, used for the tags an actor currently owns.
class.description: Backs the owned tags of [AbilitySystemComponent]. Adding the same tag twice increments its count, and it stops being owned only when the count returns to zero.

method.name: get_explicit_tags
method.description: The tags currently held, as a plain container - explicit ones only, without the ancestors a hierarchical query would also match.

method.name: get_tag_count
method.description: How many sources currently grant [param tag_name]. Zero means the container does not have the tag.

method.name: register_gameplay_tag_event
method.description: Calls [param tag_delegate] whenever [param tag]'s existence flips. Not called for a count change that keeps the tag present.

method.name: update_tag_count
method.description: Adds [param count_delta] to the tag's reference count. Returns [code]true[/code] when the tag's [i]existence[/i] flipped - 0 to above 0, or back - which is the only transition worth reacting to. Counting is what lets two sources grant the same tag: both have to release it before it goes away.
